items.title: Unblock the build loop: design_lint false positive on QR black/white literals in settings.tsx
items.description: ops/tools/loop_state.py reports EXECUTE red on 'hardcoded color #000000' in web/components/settings.tsx - but the QR fg/bg MUST stay literal black/white to scan. Add a narrow allow marker (e.g. /* lint:hex-ok */) to ops/tools/design_lint.py and annotate the QR line. Verify: python ops/tools/loop_state.py no longer red on that item; design_lint clean.

items.title: Pay debt nightshift-limit-sniff: structured limit signal from the driver
items.description: drivers._claude() already parses the stream-json result event; expose its subtype/is_error in meta, persist as last_error_type on the track, make nightshift._limit_hit() read that field (string match only as fallback). Unit-test with a synthetic result event. Flip the debt item to paid in daemon/debt.py.

items.title: Dedupe collapses distinct listings sharing (price, rounded sqm)
items.description: scraper/scan.py _sig(l) (~line 1339) keys only (int(price), round(sqm)) - different properties with same price+area silently vanish. Add a location/title component to the signature. Verify: two rows same price+sqm different urls both survive; a real cross-source dupe still merges.
